verdict.rationale: The docs show a client-side SDK method, collectFinancialConnectionsAccounts, that launches the auth flow from a client_secret, which implies an official Stripe.js integration. The llms.txt probe also refers to installing official Stripe packages from npm. However, no evidence names or documents the official server-side SDKs or languages for Financial Connections, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of official server/client SDKs and supported languages, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
